newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominican labor conciliator named for Falconbridge.
newsitem.headline: Dominican labor conciliator named for Falconbridge.

text.p: The Dominican Republic government has appointed a conciliator to work with Falconbridge Ltd and its unionized workers in that country, the company said on Monday.

Falconbridge's contract with 1,000 employees at Falconbridge Dominicana expired at the end of November, but Dominican requirements call for a mandatory period of conciliation before a strike or lockout are allowed.
The conciliator's first meetings with the company and union will be held this week, Falconbridge spokeswoman Caroline Casselman said in an interview.
"He's known to be a very experienced conciliator."
She said the company did not expect much to happen this month as management and employees celebrate the Christmas season.
In 1995, the facility produced 30,900 tonnes of nickel in ferronickel. The plant employs a total of 1,500 workers.
